project_overview: A high-fashion editorial runway presents a sequence of complete, distinct looks. This look is a relaxed denim ensemble with a youthful, contemporary styling, presented as a deliberate outfit change.
visual_direction: Premium fashion editorial, clean runway staging, confident model movement.
invariants: The same adult model appears throughout.
Each runway look is a complete outfit.
Styling is contemporary, cohesive and intentional.
scene_description: The model walks the runway in the new relaxed denim look. The preceding look was a formal tailored suit. The new look should read clearly as relaxed denim styling.
existing_h3_prompt: The model walks confidently toward the camera. She now wears relaxed blue jeans instead of the tailored suit trousers. The camera tracks backward smoothly.
expected_findings: Explicitly replace the previous formal outfit with a coherent complete relaxed denim look.
Choose a suitable top, footwear and accessories rather than retaining the previous suit elements by omission.
Choices should be plausible for relaxed contemporary denim styling, not arbitrary costume design.
Do not add new runway events, models, locations or narrative beats.
